| Folder | Upstream | Base commit | License | Changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `openmohaa` | https://github.com/openmoh/openmohaa | `a2f340195975f4f042e28a60b62561dd9a0b2700` | GPL 2 (`COPYING.txt`) | Under `#ifdef NXDK` |
| `pbgl` | https://github.com/fgsfdsfgs/pbgl | `017ab17c4530bf3e2ad446a50de9b18ea6011548` | MIT (`LICENSE`) | Marked `OGX MOHAA` |
| `printf` | https://github.com/eyalroz/printf | `92c735948e33633b141209240b3e414b86b869bf` | MIT (`LICENSE`) | None |

To see the changes against upstream, clone that commit somewhere else and compare.
